description: Tervise Arengu Instituut: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tervise Arengu Instituut. Coverage: Tervise Arengu Instituut. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: PTMU241: Ohutus jalgrattaga sõitmisel vanuserühma ja maakonna järgi; PTMU242: Ohutus jalgrattaga sõitmisel soo ja kohaliku omavalitsuse tüü; PTMU24: Ohutus jalgrattaga sõitmisel soo ja vanuserühma järgi; PTMU240: Ohutus jalgrattaga sõitmisel soo ja maakonna järgi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
